paper_cards.title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
paper_cards.data: 230K+ indoor environments, 130K objects, 48K manipulable objects, 42M stable grasps, eight benchmark tasks
paper_cards.method: Simulator-agnostic asset normalization, scene conversion, grasp generation, task configuration, rollout, and evaluation stack for MuJoCo, Isaac, and ManiSkill
paper_cards.task: Train and evaluate navigation, static/mobile manipulation, and multi-room policies under controlled long-tail variation
paper_cards.novelty: Unifies very large scene/object/grasp resources with portable simulator adapters and benchmark tooling
paper_cards.evidence: Official paper reports sim-to-real policy-ranking correlation R=0.96 and rho=0.98; repository exposes assets, configs, docs, and leaderboards.

claim_checks.claim: Public multi-simulator ecosystem and eight tasks

paper_cards.limitations: Benchmark execution is currently most mature in MuJoCo; asset/layout quality and task breadth vary.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Direct executable-world data and policy-evaluation substrate.

paper_cards.title: VLA-JEPA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Model with Latent World Model
paper_cards.data: SSV2, DROID, BridgeV2, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, SimplerEnv, and real manipulation
paper_cards.method: Leakage-free JEPA future-latent prediction from current-only observations followed by VLA action-head fine-tuning
paper_cards.task: Language-conditioned manipulation with world-model supervision that incurs no inference-time branch
paper_cards.novelty: Blocks future information leakage while learning action-relevant latent transitions instead of pixel futures
paper_cards.evidence: Paper reports consistent gains across three simulation suites and real tasks; code and LeRobot checkpoints are public.

claim_checks.claim: Future frames are targets only, never student inputs

claim_checks.notes: Repository is public but some training code is partial.

paper_cards.limitations: Manipulation-centric evaluation; partial public training code; source-reported results not reproduced.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Clean training-only latent world-model baseline for world-action policies.

paper_cards.title: Point-It-Out: Benchmarking Embodied Reasoning for Vision Language Models in Multi-Stage Visual Grounding
paper_cards.data: 600+ human-annotated QA pairs across household, kitchen, driving, and manipulation
paper_cards.method: Three-stage box, point, and visual-trace evaluation for referred localization, task grounding, and trajectory prediction
paper_cards.task: Measure precise embodied spatial grounding rather than multiple-choice recognition
paper_cards.novelty: Hierarchical pixel-level embodied reasoning benchmark that diagnoses localization-to-action failures
paper_cards.evidence: TMLR paper, official page, and public Hugging Face dataset; evaluates 10+ VLMs.
paper_cards.limitations: Modest scale, 2D outputs omit depth/force/kinematics, and no closed-loop execution.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful spatial-to-action diagnostic and reusable grounding schema.

paper_cards.title: Geometry-aware 4D Video Generation for Robot Manipulation
paper_cards.data: Multi-view RGB-D manipulation sequences, pointmaps, poses, simulated tasks, and real examples
paper_cards.method: Dual-view video diffusion with cross-attention and pointmap supervision, followed by off-the-shelf 6-DoF pose tracking
paper_cards.task: Generate geometrically aligned future RGB-D and recover executable end-effector trajectories
paper_cards.novelty: Combines temporal video generation and metric cross-view geometry for downstream manipulation
paper_cards.evidence: ICLR paper plus public code, data, checkpoints, detailed RGB/depth galleries, and policy rollouts.

claim_checks.claim: Generated 4D videos support pose extraction and execution
claim_checks.notes: Official successes and baseline failures shown.

paper_cards.limitations: Requires calibrated multi-view RGB-D and tracking; physical coverage is limited.

paper_cards.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
paper_cards.data: DROID, RLBench, Bridge, RT-1, and real UF ARM tasks
paper_cards.method: Dense correspondence distillation from a geometry foundation model into video DiT, then adaptive inverse dynamics and IK
paper_cards.task: Generate geometry-consistent futures and convert them into real/sim robot trajectories
paper_cards.novelty: Training-time geometry branch improves correspondence without inference overhead
paper_cards.evidence: Official page reports real success increasing from 61% to 81% and exposes multi-dataset and real rollouts.

claim_checks.claim: No extra geometry branch at inference

paper_cards.limitations: No public code verified; narrow physical evaluation; depends on teacher and grounding quality.

paper_cards.title: ORV: 4D Occupancy-centric Robot Video Generation
paper_cards.data: ORV-Data plus BridgeV2, DROID, and RT-1 with 4D semantic occupancy
paper_cards.method: Action-Expert AdaLN for chunked 7-DoF controls plus rendered 4D occupancy soft guidance in video diffusion
paper_cards.task: Generate controllable single/multi-view robot videos and sim-to-real augmentation
paper_cards.novelty: Uses dense occupancy to bridge sparse robot controls and pixel generation
paper_cards.evidence: Reports 18.8% lower FVD, +3.5% planning success, +6.4% policy success; public code and extensive galleries.
paper_cards.limitations: High occupancy preprocessing/storage cost, modest downstream gains, limited long-horizon evidence.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Dense executable-state conditioning for robot-video world generation.
